segments.name: RNA therapeutics
segments.description: Discovers and develops siRNA molecules and RNAi-based medicines, earning revenue from research collaborations and royalties with pharmaceutical partners.
segments.evidence: The Group operates as one reportable segment in the specific technology field of RNA therapeutics.

revenueModel.text: Pharmaceutical collaboration partners AstraZeneca and Hansoh pay upfront payments, development and regulatory milestones, FTE cost recharges and royalties on net product sales.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group is eligible to receive development, regulatory and commercial milestones as well as royalties on Hansoh net product sales.

changes.text: In 2024 Hansoh notified the Group that it would not pursue further development under the Hansoh Collaboration, ending that collaboration.
changes.evidence: In December 2024, Hansoh notified the Group that it will not pursue further development under the Hansoh Collaboration.
